newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury launches 10 mln stg chocolate bar.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury launches 10 mln stg chocolate bar.

text.p: Cadbury Schweppes Plc said on Tuesday its new chocolate bar Fuse -- developed and launched at a cost of 10 million stg -- will be on sale from today.

The launch of Fuse -- "a delicious fusion of Cadbury's milk chocolate, raisins, peanuts, crispy cereal and fudgy pieces" -- is part of Cadbury's 25 million stg autumn investment, which includes sponsorships and a new advertising campaign to promote the firm's confectionery brand.
